orange_reference.divergence_explanation: Orange applies text preprocessing (tokenization, lowercase conversion, and medical/domain stop-word removal) before scoring. Raw VADER scores the word 'heart' as +3.20 (social media affinity), causing un-preprocessed medical headlines to skew falsely positive.
